title: Can I BEAT 3 Check on Lichess?
summary: Three-check on lichess vs ~2000-2200 humans, trying to reach the top 1% of lichess three-check players; ends with a real rating better than 89% of players (needs ~2100+ for 99th percentile).
rules: Standard chess setup; every check given is counted.
Giving the 3rd check wins immediately; checkmate also wins.
win_condition: 3 checks or checkmate. Video goal: top 1% percentile (not reached; 89%).
